algorithm_change: Track how many times the per-worker pipeline entry point has been entered, so a candidate optimization can later branch on warm/cold state. The decision surface is the pipeline entry state, not a scoring threshold.
quality_preservation_argument: The added field is a counter only. The call into p7_evo_align_stock_Run and every score vector are untouched, so the exact stock fallback still handles all comparison work.
exact_fallback_strategy: p7_evo_align_stock_Run remains the unconditional implementation for this entry point; if the counter is never read, behaviour is byte-for-byte the stock path.
rationale: Example proposal used to exercise the proposal -> static verify -> apply protocol. It computes nothing and is not claimed to improve anything.
expected_metric_effect: None claimed. This is a structurally valid patch, not a result.
risk_notes: Struct layout change must stay consistent with the Create/Reuse/Destroy pair; a mismatch would be a memory error caught at build or smoke time, not silently.
_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. The diff context matches the stock p7_evo_align.c produced by patches/0001-expose-optimization-islands.patch, so it applies cleanly. It is a no-op placeholder, NOT an optimization, and NO speedup is claimed.
